verdict.rationale: A government register portal with a publication/filing platform could plausibly publish a remotely completable credential-MFA sign-in path, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes any sign-in or authentication method. The pack covers public search, the publication platform's existence, invoice email authentication (SPF/DKIM, which concerns email delivery, not user sign-in) and load limits; none of this shows MFA, biometric, in-person or postal-PIN requirements.
